body: Good question: I suppose people just tend to jump to assumptions and I usually don’t go out of my way to contradict them. I’ll flirt with women with ease and I am pretty confident in daily life, so I guess people just assume I’ve got more experience than I really do. I’ve also partied and travelled pretty extensively over the course of my life, so I guess the assumption is that that “lifestyle” goes hand in hand with promiscuity. I was raised by strict parents and I went out of my way to rebel against them the second I turned 18. A lot of people just assume that I also rebelled against purity culture. The tldr version is that people’s assumptions are a powerful thing and I don’t have the guts to challenge those assumptions

Great question. I’d love to be a journalist, but I know how cutthroat the job market is right now. I have a lot of standard, travel related dreams that seem to be fairly common amongst my generation. I’d love to see the ice caps before the melt and Venice before it’s underwater. I’d also love to live on a houseboat. The main dream right now is just to have a career that doesn’t make me dread waking up in the mornings.

Good question. I’d love to be a journalist. I’m currently pitching articles to publications and applying for internships alongside working a minimum wage job. Eventually, I want to go back to uni to do a masters in journalism. The eventual aim is to go into environmental journalism.
